The hole size and morphology of the entrance holes in the two groups were observed.The diameter of the entrance holes in the control group was about 364 m. The diameter of micro-holes in the experimental group was 368 m. Compared with the control group,the diameter of the entrance holes in the experimental group barely changed. As shown in Figure 8a and c, the morphology of the micro-hole entrance in the control group is elliptical, and the roundness of the micro-hole entrance in the experimental group is improved.The roundness of the control group and the experimental group was calculated as 88.8%and 94.1%, respectively. It is shown that the repair with small laser power will not expand the micro-hole diameter but can increase the roundness of the inlet hole if the appropriate rotary cutting diameter was selected. Figure 8b and d show SEM images of micro-holes exit in the control group and the experimental group. These two images show that the morphology of the exit holes in the control group was very poor,the eliptical outline could be seen in the exit. The energy of femtosecond laser dispersed at the end of the filament. In addition, the femtosecond laser used was linearly polarized light so in the plane perpendicular to the direction of light wave travels, the optical vector of linearly polarized light vibrates in a fixed direction, resulting in the material of exit position absorbing different laser energy. Therefore, in the position near the exit, there will be obvious outward expansion along a certain direction,and finally the exit will show an approximate rectangular outline, and the gap between the long axis and the short axis was large. Compared with the control group, the morphology of the outlet holes in the experimental group is improved.The short axis increased obviously after repairing while the long axis changed little, but the outward expansion morphology at the exit position still existed. The results show that laser repair can improve the external expansion morphology formed by the energy divergence at the end of femtosecond laser filament and the polarization state of laser. The fitting diameter of the outlet hole is expandedby 45 m and the taper of the hole is reduced. The roundness of the outlet holes in control group and the experimental group are 60.9% and 76.2%, respectively. However, the reaming effect caused by laser energy divergence can not be completely eliminated in the repair process,so the outward expansion morphology of the micro-holes after repair still exists. Figure 10shows the cross section of the control group and the experimental group. The outward expansion morphology of the pore wall can be observed intuitively from the profile of the micro-holes. In the control group, a certain taper could be observed near the exit of the micro-hole, but no obvious taper could be seen in the experimental group.
